translation_notes: Only OWL.sameAs is used inside this 6-line region, so only @prefix owl: is declared -- the draft's blanket 'prefixes: res->res, DC->dc, ...' listed a prefix for every name rdflib.namespace exports at the top of the whole source file, most of them unused here.

Dropped the draft's `@prefix res: <...>` on purpose: `res` is not used as a res:local term anywhere in this region, only as a plain Python value (res+"R-"+str(nytid)), i.e. Namespace string concatenation, not a prefixed name. Declaring `@prefix res:` shadows that Python name (the transpiler's own 'prefixed name = Python name' warning) and breaks the region with 'undefined name res'. Kept `res = Namespace(...)` as plain Python instead, exactly as in the original.

Context shim (context_shim.py): nyt, relation and rel_data are defined earlier in the same function (create_rdf), outside the extracted lines (193-198), inside a `for i, (rel, info) in enumerate(output.items()):` loop this region does not otherwise need. Restored with a real row copied verbatim from the repository's own AllRelationWithCrossCheck.csv (WikidataIds=P19, 'place of birth'/'place_of_birth', Nrid=4001) plus one neighbouring row whose RE-NYT-Relation is blank in the real file, so rel_data.loc[...] is not trivially the whole table and nyt='place_of_birth' takes the `if str(nyt) != 'nan':` branch that is this region's only RDF-producing path -- an empty-branch fixture would have been a hollow green.

Sabotage-tested: retargeting the object from {URIRef(res+"R-"+str(nytid))} to {URIRef(relation)} (the subject's own value) makes rdfeval check fail (1 vs 1 triples, not isomorphic); restored before finalising.
